lenses.label: ESO VISTA
lenses.title: ESO VISTA
lenses.description: Near-infrared colors from ESO’s VISTA survey, painted onto the shared simulated LMC density cloud.

material.scale: Radius in pixels at 1024px registered width.
material.contrast: Three coverage-normalized box passes; bounded local luminance ratio deepens dark structure, preserving highlight headroom. Authored RGB material only; no inferred depth.

alignment.convention: Use the exact saved Alignment placement, including scale, pivot, all rotations and offsets.

densityProjection.meaning: Integrated signal of the untouched Alignment density source; identical cutoff for all materials.

limitations: The Alignment cloud is simulated stellar density, not measured gas depth.
Candidate color and optional local contrast paint the fixed cloud. Image brightness never changes geometry or alpha.
Uncovered or black image samples retain neutral density colors; coverage counts record this mixed-source material.
Catalogue astrometry is preserved; one common Alignment mapping and density-conditioned model supplies the same stellar positions for every material.

approximation.method: Filtered scalar fields; decoded after filtering; integrated RGB emission; exponential shared opacity with optical RGB ratios in ordinary alpha. Material: density-opacity-image-material@2.
limitations: Shared-opacity display emission preserves column-constant chromaticity before RGBA8 quantization; varying chromaticity remains a slab approximation. Extinction is unsupported.
Finite slices and axis handoffs approximate a continuous field; angle-dependent opacity and sampling differences remain.
No runtime ray integration, near-field noise or global HDR display pass.
This is material replacement on the accepted reference cloud, not new geometry inference. Uncovered/black image regions retain neutral density color.
